sources: Antonín Dvořák (1841-1904), Symphony No. 9 'From the New World', Op. 95, II. Largo — cor anglais theme, first eight bars; public domain
notes: Theme transposed from D-flat to C so it sits in C position (C-G). The original dotted-quarter + eighth pairs (E. G | E. D | D. E G. E | D. C) are written as even quarters because level 0 allows only quarter/half/whole notes, as was done for hot-cross-buns. Written out from memory in the simplest form; no network in the build environment, so not compared against an online score. Needs a listen by a person.
